thread:
Priya: FYI budget-sentinel flagged HelixBio (acct: HELIX-77) at 02:45 UTC. Big embedding ingestion during onboarding. Need a concise QBR-ready summary and mitigation plan. :rotating_light:
Evan: looking now. Dashboard: https://console.redwood/clients/helixbio/spend — daily tokens ~1.9M, projected monthly ~57M if continued. :eyes:
Liam: they imported a full clinical_notes export without chunking or dedupe. CS ticket shows default pipeline used. We should offer an immediate low-friction fix.
Nina: I'll book a 25m enablement with their eng lead tomorrow 9am PT and prep a one-pager on Optimize presets + ingestion best practices.
Liam: quick immediate mitigations I've used before:
```
- enable embedding batching (batch_size: 128)
- run a lightweight hash-based dedupe pre-pass
- enable prefix caching for common metadata
- apply temporary throttle during onboarding peak
- consider quantizing non-prod model endpoints (int8)
```
OpsBot: [budget-alert] HELIX-77 threshold breached. Trigger: embed-ingest-bulk. today_tokens=1,912,210 projected_month=57,366,300. Suggested actions: notify-cs, temp-throttle, escalate FinOps.
Priya: For the QBR slideset we need three scenarios by COB tomorrow: conservative (dedupe + throttle + batching), median (batching + quantization on non-prod), aggressive (no changes). Include tokens & cost USD for each and a short one-line impact.
FinOpsBot: Acknowledged. Will generate token-to-dollar conversions and three sensitivity rows (adoption 25/50/100%) by EOD tomorrow.
Evan: SQL snippet I use to slice routes for the deck:
```
SELECT route, sum(tokens) AS tokens, sum(cost_usd) AS cost
FROM token_events
WHERE account_id='HELIX-77' AND ts >= '2026-03-01'
GROUP BY route
ORDER BY tokens DESC;
```
Nina: Draft customer note I'll send post-call (with an opt-in throttle checkbox):
"Hi HelixBio team — we observed a high-volume ingestion run increasing token usage. We recommend a short 25-min session to enable batching, dedupe, and the Optimize presets. We can also turn on a temporary throttle until changes are live. Reply 'THROTTLE OK' to accept immediate throttle"
Priya: Can Ops create a budget rule we can flip to pause or throttle ingestion at a safe threshold? Suggest pause when daily tokens > 2,200,000 with a fallback 60% throttle. Also ask Eng to add a pre-ingest size estimate step in their pipeline so we can trigger early alerts.
OpsBot: [action_created] budget_rule/helix-temp-throttle-192468 by Nina. Rule: pause ingestion when daily_tokens > 2,200,000; fallback_throttle=60%; notify=@customer-success.
Nina: I'll capture any doc friction notes during the session (which pages were unclear, missing examples) and paste snippets for the QBR "customer feedback" box.
Priya: Important: record whether the customer accepts the throttle and whether they adopt Optimize presets within 7 days — that will set the renewal risk color (green/amber/red).
Liam: I'll paste the enablement checklist and session notes in this thread after the call.
FinOpsBot: Once projections are ready I'll upload three slide variants to the shared QBR deck and add a per-seat ARR impact line for renewals.
Priya: Thanks team — keep updates here. Small ask: if you get a short customer quote about docs friction, drop it in plain text so I can paste into the QBR."
